sourceRefs.locator: Translated charter, preamble and clauses 1–7. Residential wall, annual payment of three and a half pounds, harbour trade, cemetery, visiting Jews, judicial jurisdiction.
Opening account of the 1084 settlement and the section Erste Pogrome, Kreuzzüge und die Pest. Attack of 1096 and the intervention of Bishop Johann.
Opening paragraph, including the ancient group’s campaign and defeat near Aquae Sextiae in 102 BCE.
Sections 1 and 2. Carolingian and Ottonian imperial title, geographic extent, development of the imperial designation and the problem of territorial authority.

labels.de: Rüdigers Rechte für die jüdische Gemeinde
labels.en: Rüdiger grants rights to the Jewish community

note.de: Bischof Rüdiger regelt Handel, Begräbnis und Gerichtsbarkeit für jüdische Familien. Der Stadtpunkt liegt am Rhein und verzeichnet den Geltungsort des Privilegs.
note.en: Bishop Rüdiger grants trading, burial and judicial rights to Jewish families in Speyer. The city marker identifies where the grant applied.
